title: Numerical artifact for Stable Solutions and Singular Representations in Neural PDE Models
description: Executable scripts, raw optimizer histories, validation summaries, and manuscript-facing figures for controlled collision and boundary-completion experiments in neural PDE trial classes. The completion geometry is prescribed; this artifact does not implement automatic collision discovery.
